codeLivewirePhp:
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Livewire\Attributes\Locked;
use Livewire\Component;

class ApprovalStepperChecklist extends Component
{
    public const STEPS = ['Intake recorded', 'Finance sign-off', 'Operations review', 'Release'];
    public const GATES = [2 => ['Verify revised capacity', 'Confirm start date'], 3 => ['Attach reviewed version', 'Confirm release owner']];
    public const FIELDS = [
        ['name' => 'Site', 'v1' => 'North Hub', 'v2' => 'North Hub'],
        ['name' => 'Capacity', 'v1' => '12 seats', 'v2' => '18 seats'],
        ['name' => 'Start', 'v1' => '04 Jan 2027', 'v2' => '11 Jan 2027'],
    ];
    #[Locked]
    public int $active = 2;
    #[Locked]
    public string $version = 'v2';
    public array $checked = [];
    public string $message = '';

    public function selectVersion(string $value): void
    {
        if (in_array($value, ['v1', 'v2'], true)) $this->version = $value;
    }

    public function begin(): void
    {
        if (!isset(self::GATES[$this->active])) return;
        $this->checked = [];
        $this->dispatch('checklist-open');
    }

    public function approve(): void
    {
        $required = self::GATES[$this->active] ?? [];
        if (!$required || array_diff($required, $this->checked)) {
            $this->addError('checked', 'Confirm each gate before approving.');
            return;
        }
        $this->message = self::STEPS[$this->active] . ' completed for v2.';
        $this->active++;
        $this->checked = [];
        $this->dispatch('checklist-done');
    }

    public function render()
    {
        return view('livewire.approval-stepper-checklist', ['steps' => self::STEPS, 'fields' => self::FIELDS, 'gates' => self::GATES[$this->active] ?? []]);
    }
}
